scripts.build: npm run build:mcp && npm run build:daemon
scripts.build:mcp: esbuild chatlytics-mcp.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --outfile=chatlytics-mcp.bundle.mjs --packages=bundle --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cl_createRequire } from \"node:module\"; const require = __cl_createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:daemon: esbuild ../daemon/wa-poll-once.mjs --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --outfile=../daemon/wa-poll-once.bundle.mjs --packages=bundle --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cl_createRequire } from \"node:module\"; const require = __cl_createRequire(import.meta.url);"
